# interfere_service (Data Source)

Read an existing service and its stored website settings by ID. Requires org:integration_settings:read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "interfere_service" "website" {
  workspace_slug = "example"
  id             = "75000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique service identifier. Applying adopts this existing service.
- `workspace_slug` (String) Workspace URL slug, using lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

### Read-Only

- `merged_into_id` (String)
- `name` (String) Telemetry service name.
- `namespace` (String) Telemetry service namespace, when supplied.
- `type` (String) Service type: unclassified, other, backend, or website.
- `website_settings` (Attributes) Service-owned website settings. Omit to preserve the stored settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--website_settings))

<a id="nestedatt--website_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `website_settings`

Read-Only:

- `anonymous_replay_policy` (String) When sessions without an identified user record replay: always, only once an error occurs, or never.
- `anonymous_user_tracking` (Boolean)
- `environment_filtering` (Boolean)
- `plugins` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--website_settings--plugins))

<a id="nestedatt--website_settings--plugins"></a>
### Nested Schema for `website_settings.plugins`

Read-Only:

- `device` (Boolean)
- `errors` (Boolean)
- `logs` (Boolean)
- `page_events` (Boolean)
- `rage_click` (Boolean)
- `replay` (Boolean)
